commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 44 and headline indices stalling amid inflation prints, O'Neil and Weinstein disciplines mandate strict defensive positioning. When the general market is under pressure and the deterministic gate is marked WEAK, institutional sponsorship wanes and breakout failure rates multiply. Livermore's core axiom—respect the general market trend—dictates that exposure must remain tight. Minervini's progressive exposure rules demand that capital commitments stay curtailed, demanding uncompromising CANSLIM C+A fundamentals and confirmed Stage 2 structural setups before deploying risk. In an unconfirmed market tape, only true market leaders with accelerating earnings warrant attention, while any fundamental deceleration caps setups at Watch.
